required_before_work: State-aware startup: read activeContext.md only; index.json and projectbrief.md are never startup payload.
If the capsule is IDLE/PARKED or does not match the latest user request, follow the latest request and do not open the old task pack.
If the user is continuing the active task, read only the exact task pack and Resume Reads named by the capsule.
Load durable project facts, requirements, modules, decisions, pitfalls and history only when the current task needs them.
Requirement synchronization, implementation, verification, production migration, deployment and real-device acceptance remain separate states.
Use bounded reads for large files and command output; prefer search plus relevant ranges.
compact_contract: Keep only task id, current goal, latest verified checkpoint, changed paths, verification results, blockers and next action.
Never preserve full file bodies, full command output, prior summaries, startup files or rule text in a compact summary.
After compaction, reread activeContext.md only; open its exact task pack only when continuation requires it.
Start a clean session between unrelated tasks instead of resuming stale conversation history.
health_checks: Enforce the single-file startup capsule and task-pack budgets.
Use CJK-aware static token estimates and report the method.
Validate paths, requirement schemas, JSONL and archive hashes.
Use claude-context-health.ps1 for user/project rules, skills and recent-session telemetry.
